_note: Player fire support (FireSupport, UavSupport; the Captain's list of 2026-10-20, 'Vehicles and air'). Everything here is Proposed. Prices per round and per UAV call are in data/prices.json "supports" (mortar_round, artillery_round, uav). units: the firing units a fire mission can go to. They fire from off the map: the guns stand off_map_m past the zone's edge on the side its supports come from (Supports.origin_for), so range and time of flight are real ones. elevation_mils: the angle the rounds fly at (the mortar high, the howitzers low), which with the range gives the time of flight (no drag). response_s: from the call to the first round fired; adjust_s: from a correction to the next. bias_m: the error a mission starts with (the guns' survey and the weather), the observer's corrections take it out; lased_bias: what's left of it for a point lased through binoculars. dispersion_m + dispersion_per_km x range (km): every round lands within that radius of where the guns aim (a uniform disc). danger_close_m: friendlies this near the aim and the guns wait for the caller to confirm (real doctrine says 600 m: shortened for our zones). max_rounds: most rounds in one fire for effect; rounds_per_op: what the unit can give one deployment of each shell. cooldown_s: after a fire for effect, before the next mission. vehicle_reach_m: a round's blast hurts a vehicle this near (more the closer), vehicle_blast_x its blast's share on a hull. min_tier: the standing (factions.json reputation_tiers) a deployment employer needs with the company to lend the unit; regions: where it reaches (the 105s sit at the inland FOB: the coast is out of their reach).
_allied_units: An operation's own guns (docs/combined_arms.md 6.1 'allied fires', 6.4; cg_brief queue item 3.3, OpSupport): never on the company's menu or bill (FireSupport.server_allied_fire). The employer's mortar section fires from where its tubes stand in the zone (in_zone), its battery and naval gunfire from off the map (the battery from the friendly side, the guns afloat from the sea side), the enemy's mortar from its own side (side 'hostile': it holds for its own men instead of ours). Rounds per operation are the contract's 'allied_fires'. All Proposed.
_uav: uav: a loitering recon drone (UavSupport). It flies in from the supports' origin at speed_ms, circles orbit_m round the point it was sent to alt_m up for loiter_s, then flies home. Its camera sees the ground within sensor_m of the point under it: a hostile in its sight (no wall or roof, less than Spotting.FOLIAGE_OPAQUE_M of tree crown in the way) is spotted after spot_s (times the Spotting factors for stance, movement, camo, foliage and weather; thermal: night doesn't hide anyone) and tagged for the squad (EnemyTags) every tag_every_s while it's seen. Storms ground it (DayNight.grounds_aircraft). hits rounds bring it down; a manned hostile AA technical within aa_reach_m with a clear line has aa_hit_chance every aa_every_s to hit it.
